/* QuickSight */
SELECT ds.* FROM ( WITH max_month AS (
    SELECT date_trunc('month', MAX(DATE_PARSE(business_date, '%Y-%m-%d'))) AS latest_month
    FROM risk_prod.rmv_position
    WHERE portfolio_type = 'IP'
),
date_filtered AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM risk_prod.rmv_position, max_month
    WHERE portfolio_type = 'IP'
      AND DATE_PARSE(business_date, '%Y-%m-%d') BETWEEN
          DATE_PARSE(CAST(year(latest_month) - 1 AS VARCHAR) || '-04-01', '%Y-%m-%d')
          AND date_add('day', -1, date_add('month', 1, latest_month))
),
ranked_dates AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        DATE_PARSE(business_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS bd,
        row_number() OVER (ORDER BY DATE_PARSE(business_date, '%Y-%m-%d') DESC) AS rn
    FROM date_filtered
),
reference_dates AS (
    SELECT
        MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN bd END) AS max_bd,
        MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN bd END) AS t_1,
        MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 3 THEN bd END) AS t_2
    FROM ranked_dates
)
SELECT 
    df.*, 
    rd.t_1, 
    rd.t_2, 
    'AWS_SSO_QSAdmin_Risk' AS "group"
FROM 
    date_filtered df
CROSS JOIN 
    reference_dates rd ) ds LIMIT 0

With CONSTANTS as (
  --This returns a single record 
  Select 
    'One-time funding'          as ONE_TIME_FUNDING,
    'Multi-period funding'      as MULTI_PERIOD_FUNDING,
    'Deployment'                as DEPLOYMENT,
    'Disposition'               as DISPOSITION,
    'Antares'                   as ANTARES,
    'Active Credit ex. Antares' as EX_ANTARES,
    'Y'                         as IGNORE_FLAG_YES,
    'N'                         as IGNORE_FLAG_NO,
    'On Hold'                   as ON_HOLD_STATUS,
    'Watchlist'                 as WATCH_LIST_STATUS,
    'Passed/Dead'               as PASSED_DEAD_STATUS
)
Select
    --META DATA
    DC_Staging.source                           as source,
    DC_Staging.business_date                    as business_date,
    DC_Staging.run_id                           as run_id,
    DC_Staging.extract_timestamp                as extract_timestamp,
    DC_Staging.extract_timestamp_iso_8601       as extract_timestamp_iso_8601,
    DC_Staging.extract_timestamp_time_zone      as extract_timestamp_time_zone,

    --------------------------------------
    -- identifiers
    --------------------------------------  
    DC_Staging.dc_dealcloud_opportunity_id                    as upstream_pipeline_number,  
    DC_Staging.dc_dealcloud_opportunity_id                    as deal_id,
    DC_Staging.dc_dealcloud_opportunity_id                    as source_data_id,
    Null                                                      as sentry_security_id,
    Null                                                      as sentry_issuer_id,
    --------------------------------------
    -- DC Reference
    -------------------------------------- 
    Case
      When DC_Staging.dc_opportunity_deal_name = CONST.ANTARES Then CONST.ANTARES
      Else CONST.EX_ANTARES
    End                                                       as strategy,
    DC_Staging.dc_cppib_group                                 as sub_strategy,
    DC_Staging.dc_opportunity_deal_name                       as project_name,
    DC_Staging.dc_opportunity_deal_name                       as investment_name,
    DC_Staging.dc_stage                                       as investment_lifecycle,
    DC_Staging.dc_probability_of_closing                      as probability_of_close,
    DC_Staging.dc_country_of_exposure                         as country_of_exposure,
    DC_Staging.dc_funding_currency                            as funding_currency,    
    DC_Staging.dc_private_vs_public                           as private_vs_public,    
    DC_Staging.dc_binding_classification                      as binding,
    DC_Staging.dc_asset_category                              as asset_category,
    DC_Staging.dc_seniority                                   as seniority,
    DC_Staging.dc_risk_rating                                 as risk_rating,
    DC_Staging.dc_gics_sector                                 as sector, 
    DC_Staging.dc_cppib_sub_group_strategy                    as inv_sub_strategy_corporates,    
    --------------------------------------
    -- 'expected'-related fields
    --------------------------------------       
    Case DC_Staging.dc_funding_frequency
      When CONST.ONE_TIME_FUNDING     Then DC_Staging.dc_expected_funding_date
      When CONST.MULTI_PERIOD_FUNDING Then DC_Staging.dc_trade_date
      Else Null
    End                                                       as expected_funding_date,
    Case DC_Staging.dc_funding_frequency
      When CONST.ONE_TIME_FUNDING     Then DC_Staging.dc_expected_close_date
      When CONST.MULTI_PERIOD_FUNDING Then DC_Staging.dc_trade_date
      Else Null
    End                                                       as expected_trade_date,

    DC_Staging.dc_expected_full_funding_amt_deal_currency_mm * 1000000     as expected_full_funding_amt_deal_currency_mm,
    Case 
      When DC_Staging.dc_expected_full_funding_amt_deal_currency_mm > 0 Then CONST.DEPLOYMENT
      When DC_Staging.dc_expected_full_funding_amt_deal_currency_mm < 0 Then CONST.DISPOSITION
      Else CONST.DISPOSITION
    End                                                                    as deployment_disposition,
    DC_Staging.dc_expected_full_funding_amt_deal_currency_mm * 1000000  
               * (DC_Staging.dc_probability_of_closing /100)  as probability_weighted_investment_amount_local,
    --------------------------------------
    -- 'fixed as per BRD
    -------------------------------------- 
    DC_Staging.investment_department_id                       as investment_department_id,
    DC_Staging.investment_status                              as investment_status,
    DC_Staging.capital_usage_component                        as capital_usage_component,
    DC_Staging.transaction_cash_flow_type                     as transaction_cash_flow_type,
    DC_Staging.send_to_treasury_y_n                           as send_to_treasury_y_n,
    --------------------------------------
    -- created by and updated by fields
    --------------------------------------
    DC_Staging.last_updated_by                                as last_updated_by,
    DC_Staging.last_updated_date                              as last_updated_date,
    DC_Staging.created_by_user_group                          as created_by_user_group,
    DC_Staging.created_by                                     as created_by,
    DC_Staging.date_updated                                   as date_updated,   
    --------------------------------------
    -- null on purpose (from requirements)
    --------------------------------------    
    DC_Staging.fo_comments                                    as fo_comments,
    DC_Staging.pec_recusals                                   as pec_recusals,
    DC_Staging.pec_pipeline_y_n                               as pec_pipeline_y_n,
    DC_Staging.fx_spot                                        as fx_spot,
    DC_Staging.full_amt_cad_mm                                as full_amt_cad_mm,  
    DC_Staging.ticket_number                                  as ticket_number,
    DC_Staging.model_portfolio_code                           as model_portfolio_code,
    DC_Staging.luxco_and_other_jurisdictions_funding_required as luxco_and_other_jurisdictions_funding_required,
    DC_Staging.luxco_and_other_jurisdictions_funding_date     as luxco_and_other_jurisdictions_funding_date,
    DC_Staging.luxco_and_other_jurisdictions_funding_amount   as luxco_and_other_jurisdictions_funding_amount, 
    DC_Staging.rejected_deals_reason                          as rejected_deals_reason,                     
    --------------------------------------
    -- comment and error
    --------------------------------------
     Case
      When DC_status = CONST.ON_HOLD_STATUS    Then DC_Staging.comment || IF(DC_Staging.comment IS NOT NULL AND DC_Staging.comment <>  '', ';DCTStatus: ', 'DCTStatus: ') || CONST.ON_HOLD_STATUS
      When DC_status = CONST.WATCH_LIST_STATUS Then DC_Staging.comment || IF(DC_Staging.comment IS NOT NULL AND DC_Staging.comment <>  '', ';DCTStatus: ', 'DCTStatus: ') || CONST.WATCH_LIST_STATUS
      When DC_status = CONST.PASSED_DEAD_STATUS Then DC_Staging.comment || IF(DC_Staging.comment IS NOT NULL AND DC_Staging.comment <> '', ';DCTStatus: ', 'DCTStatus: ') || CONST.PASSED_DEAD_STATUS
      --When coalesce(date(DC_Staging.dc_trade_date),date('1900-01-01')) <= date(DC_Staging.business_date) Then 
      --     DC_Staging.comment || IF(DC_Staging.comment IS NOT NULL AND DC_Staging.comment <> '', ';DCT: ', 'DCT: ') || 'Trade date in the past'
      Else DC_Staging.comment
    End                                                       as comment,  
    Null                                                      as error,      
    Case 
      When DC_status = CONST.ON_HOLD_STATUS    Then CONST.IGNORE_FLAG_YES
      When DC_status = CONST.WATCH_LIST_STATUS Then CONST.IGNORE_FLAG_YES
      When DC_status = CONST.PASSED_DEAD_STATUS Then CONST.IGNORE_FLAG_YES
      -- When coalesce(date(DC_Staging.dc_trade_date),date('1900-01-01')) <= date(DC_Staging.business_date) Then CONST.IGNORE_FLAG_YES
      Else CONST.IGNORE_FLAG_NO
    End                                                       as ignore_y_n,

    DC_Staging.dc_opportunity_source                          as dc_opportunity_source,
    DC_Staging.dc_opportunity_source_date                     as dc_opportunity_source_date,
    DC_Staging.dc_dealcloud_opportunity_id                    as dc_dealcloud_opportunity_id,
    DC_Staging.dc_opportunity_deal_name                       as dc_opportunity_deal_name,
    DC_Staging.dc_status                                      as dc_status,
    DC_Staging.dc_stage                                       as dc_stage,
    DC_Staging.dc_cppib_group                                 as dc_cppib_group,
    DC_Staging.dc_cppib_sub_group_strategy                    as dc_cppib_sub_group_strategy,
    DC_Staging.dc_funding_frequency                           as dc_funding_frequency,
    DC_Staging.dc_expected_close_date                         as dc_expected_close_date,
    DC_Staging.dc_probability_of_closing                      as dc_probability_of_closing,
    DC_Staging.dc_cppib_investment_size                       as dc_cppib_investment_size,
    DC_Staging.dc_binding_classification                      as dc_binding_classification,
    DC_Staging.dc_asset_category                              as dc_asset_category,
    DC_Staging.dc_seniority                                   as dc_seniority,
    DC_Staging.dc_risk_rating                                 as dc_risk_rating,
    DC_Staging.dc_gics_sector                                 as dc_gics_sector,
    DC_Staging.dc_private_vs_public                           as dc_private_vs_public,
    DC_Staging.dc_country_of_exposure                         as dc_country_of_exposure,
    DC_Staging.dc_dfs_id                                      as dc_dfs_id,
    DC_Staging.dc_funding_source_date                         as dc_funding_source_date,
    DC_Staging.dc_funding_currency                            as dc_funding_currency,
    DC_Staging.dc_expected_full_funding_amt_deal_currency_mm  as dc_expected_full_funding_amt_deal_currency_mm,
    DC_Staging.dc_expected_funding_date                       as dc_expected_funding_date,    
    DC_Staging.dc_funding_status                              as dc_funding_status,
    DC_Staging.dc_probability_of_funding                      as dc_probability_of_funding,
    DC_Staging.dc_trade_date                                  as dc_trade_date,
    DC_Staging.dc_send_to_treasury                            as dc_send_to_treasury,
    DC_Staging.dc_ticket_number                               as dc_ticket_number,
    DC_Staging.dc_model_portfolio_code                        as dc_model_portfolio_code,
    DC_Staging.dc_expected_funding_currency                   as dc_expected_funding_currency,
    coalesce(REF.has_dw_transactions_y_n, 'N')                as has_dw_transactions_y_n,
    REF.dc_opportunity_id                                     as ref_dc_opportunity_id    
From
    ci_etl_db_dev.ci_capital_pipeline_dealcloud_staging DC_Staging
    Left Join  ci_etl_db_dev.ci_capital_pipeline_sentry_reference REF ON  DC_Staging.run_id = REF.run_id
      AND DC_Staging.dc_dealcloud_opportunity_id = REF.dc_opportunity_id

    DC_Staging.dc_cppib_sub_group_strategy                    as inv_sub_strategy_corporates,    
    --------------------------------------
    -- 'expected'-related fields
    --------------------------------------       
    Case DC_Staging.dc_funding_frequency
      When CONST.ONE_TIME_FUNDING     Then DC_Staging.dc_expected_funding_date
      When CONST.MULTI_PERIOD_FUNDING Then DC_Staging.dc_trade_date

    End                                                       as expected_trade_date,

    DC_Staging.dc_expected_full_funding_amt_deal_currency_mm * 1000000     as expected_full_funding_amt_deal_currency_mm,
    Case 
      When DC_Staging.dc_expected_full_funding_amt_deal_currency_mm > 0 Then CONST.DEPLOYMENT
      When DC_Staging.dc_expected_full_funding_amt_deal_currency_mm < 0 Then CONST.DISPOSITION
      Else CONST.DISPOSITION
    End                                                                    as deployment_disposition,
    DC_Staging.dc_expected_full_funding_amt_deal_currency_mm * 1000000  
               * (DC_Staging.dc_probability_of_closing /100)  as probability_weighted_investment_amount_local,
    --------------------------------------
    -- 'fixed as per BRD
    --------------------------------------

    DC_Staging.investment_status                              as investment_status,

    DC_Staging.transaction_cash_flow_type                     as transaction_cash_flow_type,

    DC_Staging.last_updated_date                              as last_updated_date,
    DC_Staging.created_by_user_group                          as created_by_user_group,

    DC_Staging.rejected_deals_reason                          as rejected_deals_reason,                     
    --------------------------------------
    -- comment and error
    --------------------------------------
     Case
      When DC_status = CONST.ON_HOLD_STATUS    Then DC_Staging.comment || IF(DC_Staging.comment IS NOT NULL AND DC_Staging.comment <>  '', ';DCTStatus: ', 'DCTStatus: ') || CONST.ON_HOLD_STATUS

    Null                                                      as error,

      When DC_status = CONST.ON_HOLD_STATUS    Then CONST.IGNORE_FLAG_YES
      When DC_status = CONST.WATCH_LIST_STATUS Then CONST.IGNORE_FLAG_YES
      When DC_status = CONST.PASSED_DEAD_STATUS Then CONST.IGNORE_FLAG_YES
      -- When coalesce(date(DC_Staging.dc_trade_date),date('1900-01-01')) <= date(DC_Staging.business_date) Then CONST.IGNORE_FLAG_YES
      Else CONST.IGNORE_FLAG_NO

    DC_Staging.dc_funding_currency                            as dc_funding_currency,

	shm.long_settlement_correction_value_quotation_currency,
	shm.next_dividend_quotation_currency,
	shm.next_coupon_quotation_currency,
	shm.balance_nominal_number_unsettled,

	case 
	    when shm.abor_security_type_id in ('FUT_EQT','FUT_BOND','FUT_IR', 'FUT_COMDTY') then es.esm_country_code
	    when shm.abor_security_type_id = 'CDS' then null
	    else ss.abor_country_id 
	end as issuer_country_code

left join (
	select *,
	row_number() over (partition by abor_security_id order by business_date desc) as rn
	from asset.enterprise_security
) es
	on shm.abor_security_id = es.abor_security_id
	and es.rn = 1
left join (
	select *,
	row_number() over (partition by cppib_sec_id order by business_date desc) as rn
	from asset.asset_security_identifiers
) asi
	on shm.cppib_sec_id = cast(asi.cppib_sec_id as varchar(50))
	and asi.rn = 1
left join reference.scd_model_portfolio smp
	on smp.business_date = (select max(business_date) from reference.scd_model_portfolio)
	and shm.model_portfolio_id = smp.model_portfolio_id
left join reference.scd_securities ss
	on ss.business_date = (select max(business_date) from reference.scd_securities)
	and shm.abor_security_number = ss.abor_security_number
left join (
	select *, 
	row_number() over(partition by portfolio_id order by business_date desc) latest
	from reference.scd_portfolio
) sp
	on sp.latest = 1
	and shm.portfolio_id = sp.portfolio_id
left join performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten spif
	on spif.business_date = (select max(business_date) from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten)
	and shm.model_portfolio_id = spif.model_portfolio
	and spif.investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
left join reference.reference_country_codes rcc

	and asi.incorp_country_code = rcc.country_code
left join reference.scd_securities ss_ul
	on cast(ss_ul.scd_security_key_id as varchar) = es.esm_underlying_instrument_id 
	and cast(ss_ul.business_date as date) = es.business_date
	and es.enterprise_security_source = 'SCD'
left join reference.reference_country_codes rcc_esm
	on rcc_esm.business_date = (select max(business_date) from reference.reference_country_codes)
	and es.esm_country_code = rcc_esm.country_code
left join reference.reference_country_codes rcc_incorp_country
	on rcc_incorp_country.business_date = (select max(business_date) from reference.reference_country_codes)
	and es.esm_incorp_country_code = rcc_incorp_country.country_code
left join reference.reference_exchange_codes rec
	on es.esm_exchange_name = rec.exchange_name
	and coalesce(es.mic, 'null') = coalesce(rec.mic, 'null')
	and es.esm_exchange_name != 'UNKNOWN'
	and rec.business_date = (select max(business_date) from reference.reference_exchange_codes)
left join reference.reference_country_codes rcc_trade_country
	on rec.country_ref_code = rcc_trade_country.country_code
	and rcc_trade_country.business_date = (select max(business_date) from reference.reference_country_codes)
left join (
	select *, 
	row_number() over(partition by id_instrument order by business_date desc) latest
	from trades_deals.irs_trades
) it
	on it.latest = 1
	and shm.abor_security_number = it.id_instrument) AS "holdings_base"

                to_currency_code as BASE_CRNCY,
                from_currency_code as LOCAL_CRNCY,
                CASE WHEN from_currency_code = 'USD' AND to_currency_code in ('EUR','GBP')
                THEN 1/bid_value ELSE bid_value END AS BID_VAL,
                CASE WHEN from_currency_code = 'USD' AND to_currency_code in ('EUR','GBP')
                THEN 1/askvalue ELSE askvalue END AS ASK_VAL,
                CASE WHEN from_currency_code = 'USD' AND to_currency_code in ('EUR','GBP')
                THEN 1/mid_value ELSE mid_value END AS MID_VAL,
                price_source_code as price_source_cd ,
                rate_last_updated_date_time as LastUpdate
                from market.cppib_rates
                where source_code = 'WM Company'
                and rate_type in ('SPOT', 'CROSS')
                and from_currency_code IN ('CAD','USD')
                and tenor_code IS null
                and business_date >= date '2025-06-09' AND business_date <= date '2025-06-18'

/* cppi::5c26a92bdd6a653161575e94f55da607a015094a16a853b44b31703fdb06f966 */
SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafprod_yn4b94.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 19
		AND hour between 02 and 03
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-19 02:08:36'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

/* cppi::d3fab5ff7c544ae74f7dc898333a51d7e7a7a5a8afafcc3ee8fa766da05c3faf */
/* QuickSight ec0269fe-b583-4cc0-b330-713b87706f76 */
SELECT "id_model_portfolio", "InvestmentStructureLevel1", "InvestmentStructureLevel2", "from_date", "to_date", "from_date_total_market_value_pc", "to_date_total_market_value_pc"
FROM (/*
 * IDENTIFY UNMAPPED MPs IN HOLDINGS LOOKTHROUGH
 */	
select
	  id_model_portfolio 
	, InvestmentStructureLevel1
	, InvestmentStructureLevel2
	, from_date
	, to_date
	, sum( from_date_total_market_value_pc ) as from_date_total_market_value_pc
	, sum( to_date_total_market_value_pc ) as to_date_total_market_value_pc
from (
	select distinct
		  mhl.id_model_portfolio 
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel2
		, min( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) as from_date
		, max( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) as to_date
		, case 
			when mhl.business_date = min( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end from_date_total_market_value_pc
		, case
			when mhl.business_date = max( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc 
		  end to_date_total_market_value_pc
	from 
		holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough mhl
	/* MAP TO INVESTMENT STRUCTURE */
	left join
		( 	select *
			from 	performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
			where 	investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
					and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten )
		) spif
			on mhl.id_model_portfolio = spif.model_portfolio
	where
		mhl.id_model_portfolio != 'PMIEMFLTCC' -- temporary exclusion
		and mhl.pool_name not in ( 'ACPP', 'BCPP' )
		and spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1 is null
	order by 
		  mhl.id_model_portfolio 
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel2
)
group by 
	  id_model_portfolio 
	, InvestmentStructureLevel1
	, InvestmentStructureLevel2
	, from_date
	, to_date) AS "finsights_control_holdings_unmapped_mp"

-- This query retrieves holdings data and joins it with coupon and security-level
-- metadata. It filters the results based on selected asset types and seniorities,
-- and enriches each record with maturity dates and expected exit information.
-- The data is sourced as-of the latest available business date for accurate and
-- timely reporting.
--
-- Acronyms:
--   ABS   : Asset-Backed Security
--   CLO   : Collateralized Loan Obligation
--   CMBS  : Commercial Mortgage-Backed Securities
--   NPL   : Non-Performing Loan
--   HRR   : High-Risk Rated
--
-- Data Lineage Summary:
--   Security Metadata: reference.ci_sentry_security
--     (Reference - asset type, seniority, etc.)
--   Coupon Metadata:   reference.ci_sentry_security_coupon
--     (Reference - maturity dates and coupon terms)
--
-- Parameters:
--   business_date : Latest business date available in ci_sentry_security.
--
-- v1.0.1 | 2025-04-09 | kbaxter@cppib.com
--   - Initial creation: joins holdings with security and coupon metadata,
--     includes filters for asset type and seniority, and applies latest
--     business date.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- v1.1.0 | 2025-04-28 | kbaxter@cppib.com
--   - Created the Issuer CTE to handle scenarios where a security does not have 
--     an issuer. 
--   - Removed the PARAMS CTE
--   - Added handling for table replacement by environment
--   - Added cppib_security_id to the misc section.  
--   - Corrected the field name inv_sub_strategy
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- v1.1.1 | 2025-04-29 | kbaxter@cppib.com
--   - Added timestamp fields - iso and regular
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- v1.2.0 | 2025-05-22 | gstoffer@cppib.com
-- - Updated query to match new schema
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- v1.2.1 | 2025-06-13 | daniellee@cppib.com
-- - Renamed the followling columns:
--   - sentry_security_src_business_date
--   - sentry_coupon_src_business_date
--   - sentry_issuer_src_business_date
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- v1.2.2 | 2025-06-16 | kbaxter@cppib.com
-- - Added the has_transactions_y_n field based on a distinct query against ci_sentry_cashflows_all_transactions
-- - Added the dc_opportunity_id column from the ci_sentry_security
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

WITH

eligible_securities AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM reference_dev.ci_sentry_security
    WHERE sentry_security_type NOT IN ('rateIndex', 'loanContract', 'creditAgreement')
      AND CAST(business_date AS DATE) = CAST('2025-06-17' AS DATE)
      AND CAST('2025-06-17' AS DATE) >= CAST(start_date AS DATE)
      AND CAST('2025-06-17' AS DATE) <= CAST(end_date AS DATE)
),

inv_group_mapping AS (
    SELECT 'CS'    AS inv_group, 'Capital Solutions'    AS inv_group_long UNION ALL
    SELECT 'EC'    AS inv_group, 'European Credit'      AS inv_group_long UNION ALL
    SELECT 'RAC'   AS inv_group, 'Real Assets Credit'   AS inv_group_long UNION ALL
    SELECT 'APAC'  AS inv_group, 'APAC Credit'          AS inv_group_long UNION ALL
    SELECT 'PC'    AS inv_group, 'Public Credit'        AS inv_group_long
),

inv_strategy_mapping AS (
    SELECT 'APAC Capital Solutions'             AS inv_strategy, 'Capital Solutions'              AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'APAC IG Illiquid'                   AS inv_strategy, 'IG Illiquid'                    AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'APAC Real Estate Credit'            AS inv_strategy, 'Real Estate Credit'             AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'APAC Sponsor Financing'             AS inv_strategy, 'Sponsor Financing'              AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'CS Antares'                         AS inv_strategy, 'Antares'                        AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'CS Asset Backed'                    AS inv_strategy, 'Asset Backed & Financials'      AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'CS CLO'                             AS inv_strategy, 'CLO'                            AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'CS Corporates'                      AS inv_strategy, 'Corporates'                     AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'CS IG Illiquid'                     AS inv_strategy, 'IG Illiquid'                    AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'CS IP & Royalties'                  AS inv_strategy, 'Life Science & IP'              AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'CS Latam'                           AS inv_strategy, 'Latam'                          AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'EC IG Illiquid'                     AS inv_strategy, 'IG Illiquid'                    AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'EC Corporate Rel Val'               AS inv_strategy, 'Corporate Rel Val'              AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'EC NPLs'                            AS inv_strategy, 'NPLs'                           AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'EC Structured Credit'               AS inv_strategy, 'Structured Credit'              AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'RAC IG Illiquid'                    AS inv_strategy, 'IG Illiquid'                    AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'RAC Infrastructure'                 AS inv_strategy, 'Infrastructure'                 AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'RAC Real Estate'                    AS inv_strategy, 'Real Estate'                    AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'RAC Sustainable Energies Credit'    AS inv_strategy, 'Sustainable Energies'           AS inv_sub_strategy_override
),

coupon_list AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        coupon.business_date,
        coupon.security_identifier,
        coupon.sentry_security_type,
        CASE
            WHEN coupon.sentry_security_type IN (
                'delayedDrawFacility',
                'revolvingCreditFacility',
                'termLoanFacility'
            ) THEN coupon.facility_maturity_date
            ELSE coupon.colc_maturity_date
        END AS maturity_date
    FROM reference_dev.ci_sentry_security_coupon AS coupon
    WHERE CAST(coupon.business_date AS DATE) = CAST('2025-06-17' AS DATE)
),

issuer_list AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM reference_dev.ci_sentry_issuer AS issuer
    WHERE CAST(issuer.business_date AS DATE) = CAST('2025-06-17' AS DATE)
      AND CAST('2025-06-17' AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST(issuer.start_date AS DATE) AND CAST(issuer.end_date AS DATE)
),

has_transaction_list as (
    SELECT DISTINCT security_identifier, 'Y' as has_transactions_y_n
    FROM trades_deals_uat.ci_sentry_cashflows_all_transactions trans
    WHERE
        CAST(trans.business_date AS DATE) = CAST('2025-06-17' AS DATE)
        and trans.transaction_type = 'transaction' AND trans.is_cancelled = 'False' 
        AND CAST(trans.trade_date AS DATE) < CAST('2025-06-17' AS DATE)
        AND trans.security_type NOT IN ('rateIndex', 'loanContract', 'creditAgreement')
)

SELECT
    'Sentry Reference'                           AS source
   , '2025-06-17'                           AS business_date
   , '0bdd3141-e703-4be7-b6b0-7a222d9421b1'                                  AS run_id
   , '2025-06-18 23:19:05'                       AS extract_timestamp
   , '2025-06-18T23:19:05.948541-04:00'              AS extract_timestamp_iso_8601
   , 'America/Toronto'             AS extract_timestamp_time_zone
   , NULL                                        AS account_id
   , SEC.scd_id                                  AS scd_id
   , SEC.security_identifier                     AS security_identifier
   , SEC.issuer_identifier                       AS issuer_identifier
   , SEC.cppib_security_id                       AS cppib_security_id
   , ISSUER.cppib_entity_id                      AS sentry_issuer_id
   , NULL                                        AS source_data_id
   , SEC.scd_id                                  AS sentry_security_id
   , NULL                                        AS model_portfolio_code
   , SEC.scd_id                                  AS deal_id
   , SEC.dc_opportunity_id                       AS upstream_pipeline_number
   , SEC.security_name                           AS security_name
   , SEC.id_signal                               AS strategy
   , SEC.inv_group                               AS sub_strategy
   , SEC.security_name                           AS project_name
   , SEC.security_name                           AS investment_name
   , ISSUER.country_of_exposure                  AS country_of_exposure
   , SEC.currency                                AS funding_currency
   , NULL                                        AS deal_currency
   , SEC.private_vs_public                       AS private_vs_public
   , SEC.asset_category                          AS asset_category
   , SEC.seniority                               AS seniority
   , SEC.ir_rating                               AS risk_rating

-- This query retrieves holdings data and joins it with coupon and security-level
-- metadata. It filters the results based on selected asset types and seniorities,
-- and enriches each record with maturity dates and expected exit information.
-- The data is sourced as-of the latest available business date for accurate and
-- timely reporting.
--
-- Acronyms:
--   ABS   : Asset-Backed Security
--   CLO   : Collateralized Loan Obligation
--   CMBS  : Commercial Mortgage-Backed Securities
--   NPL   : Non-Performing Loan
--   HRR   : High-Risk Rated
--
-- Data Lineage Summary:
--   Security Metadata: reference.ci_sentry_security
--     (Reference - asset type, seniority, etc.)
--   Coupon Metadata:   reference.ci_sentry_security_coupon
--     (Reference - maturity dates and coupon terms)
--
-- Parameters:
--   business_date : Latest business date available in ci_sentry_security.
--
-- v1.0.1 | 2025-04-09 | kbaxter@cppib.com
--   - Initial creation: joins holdings with security and coupon metadata,
--     includes filters for asset type and seniority, and applies latest
--     business date.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- v1.1.0 | 2025-04-28 | kbaxter@cppib.com
--   - Created the Issuer CTE to handle scenarios where a security does not have 
--     an issuer. 
--   - Removed the PARAMS CTE

WITH

eligible_securities AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM reference_dev.ci_sentry_security
    WHERE sentry_security_type NOT IN ('rateIndex', 'loanContract', 'creditAgreement')
      AND CAST(business_date AS DATE) = CAST('2025-06-17' AS DATE)
      AND CAST('2025-06-17' AS DATE) >= CAST(start_date AS DATE)
      AND CAST('2025-06-17' AS DATE) <= CAST(end_date AS DATE)
),

inv_group_mapping AS (
    SELECT 'CS'    AS inv_group, 'Capital Solutions'    AS inv_group_long UNION ALL
    SELECT 'EC'    AS inv_group, 'European Credit'      AS inv_group_long UNION ALL
    SELECT 'RAC'   AS inv_group, 'Real Assets Credit'   AS inv_group_long UNION ALL
    SELECT 'APAC'  AS inv_group, 'APAC Credit'          AS inv_group_long UNION ALL
    SELECT 'PC'    AS inv_group, 'Public Credit'        AS inv_group_long
),

inv_strategy_mapping AS (
    SELECT 'APAC Capital Solutions'             AS inv_strategy, 'Capital Solutions'              AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'APAC IG Illiquid'                   AS inv_strategy, 'IG Illiquid'                    AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'APAC Real Estate Credit'            AS inv_strategy, 'Real Estate Credit'             AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL

    SELECT 'CS Asset Backed'                    AS inv_strategy, 'Asset Backed & Financials'      AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'CS CLO'                             AS inv_strategy, 'CLO'                            AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'CS Corporates'                      AS inv_strategy, 'Corporates'                     AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'CS IG Illiquid'                     AS inv_strategy, 'IG Illiquid'                    AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'CS IP & Royalties'                  AS inv_strategy, 'Life Science & IP'              AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'CS Latam'                           AS inv_strategy, 'Latam'                          AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'EC IG Illiquid'                     AS inv_strategy, 'IG Illiquid'                    AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'EC Corporate Rel Val'               AS inv_strategy, 'Corporate Rel Val'              AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'EC NPLs'                            AS inv_strategy, 'NPLs'                           AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'EC Structured Credit'               AS inv_strategy, 'Structured Credit'              AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL

    SELECT 'RAC Sustainable Energies Credit'    AS inv_strategy, 'Sustainable Energies'           AS inv_sub_strategy_override
),

coupon_list AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        coupon.business_date,
        coupon.security_identifier,
        coupon.sentry_security_type,
        CASE
            WHEN coupon.sentry_security_type IN (
                'delayedDrawFacility',
                'revolvingCreditFacility',
                'termLoanFacility'
            ) THEN coupon.facility_maturity_date
            ELSE coupon.colc_maturity_date
        END AS maturity_date
    FROM reference_dev.ci_sentry_security_coupon AS coupon
    WHERE CAST(coupon.business_date AS DATE) = CAST('2025-06-17' AS DATE)
),

issuer_list AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM reference_dev.ci_sentry_issuer AS issuer
    WHERE CAST(issuer.business_date AS DATE) = CAST('2025-06-17' AS DATE)
      AND CAST('2025-06-17' AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST(issuer.start_date AS DATE) AND CAST(issuer.end_date AS DATE)

has_transaction_list as (

    FROM trades_deals_uat.ci_sentry_cashflows_all_transactions trans
    WHERE
        CAST(trans.business_date AS DATE) = CAST('2025-06-17' AS DATE)
        and trans.transaction_type = 'transaction' AND trans.is_cancelled = 'False' 
        AND CAST(trans.trade_date AS DATE) < CAST('2025-06-17' AS DATE)
        AND trans.security_type NOT IN ('rateIndex', 'loanContract', 'creditAgreement')
)

		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafnonprod_azf8db.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 19
		AND hour between 16 and 17
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-19 16:06:23'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

				    PARTITION BY currencyCode,
				    grouped_usd,
				    data_diff
			    ) as currencyToUsdRate,
                MAX(currencyToCadRate) OVER (
                    PARTITION BY currencyCode,
                    grouped_cad,
                    data_diff
                ) as currencyToCadRate
			FROM (
				SELECT date,
					currencyCode,
					currencyToCadRate,
					currencyToUsdRate,
					COUNT(currencyToCadRate) OVER (
						PARTITION BY currencyCode
						ORDER BY date
					) as grouped_cad,
					COUNT(currencyToUsdRate) OVER (
						PARTITION BY currencyCode
						ORDER BY date
					) as grouped_usd,
					date - LAG(date, 3) OVER(
						PARTITION BY currencyCode
						ORDER BY date
					) as data_diff
				FROM (
						SELECT erc.data_date AS date,
								erc.currency AS currencyCode,

								erd.exchange_rate AS currencyToUsdRate,
								erc.is_exchange_holiday_flag as holiday_flag

								AND erc.vendor = erd.vendor

    SELECT date_trunc('month', MAX(DATE_PARSE(business_date, '%Y-%m-%d'))) AS latest_month
    FROM risk_prod.rmv_position
    WHERE portfolio_type = 'IP'
),
date_filtered AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM risk_prod.rmv_position, max_month
    WHERE portfolio_type = 'IP'
      AND DATE_PARSE(business_date, '%Y-%m-%d') BETWEEN
          DATE_PARSE(CAST(year(latest_month) - 1 AS VARCHAR) || '-04-01', '%Y-%m-%d')
          AND date_add('day', -1, date_add('month', 1, latest_month))
),
ranked_dates AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        DATE_PARSE(business_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS bd,
        row_number() OVER (ORDER BY DATE_PARSE(business_date, '%Y-%m-%d') DESC) AS rn
    FROM date_filtered
),
reference_dates AS (
    SELECT
        MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN bd END) AS max_bd,
        MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN bd END) AS t_1,
        MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 3 THEN bd END) AS t_2
    FROM ranked_dates
)
SELECT 
    df.*, 
    rd.t_1, 
    rd.t_2, 
    'AWS_SSO_QSAdmin_Risk' AS "group"
FROM 
    date_filtered df
CROSS JOIN 
    reference_dates rd ) ds LIMIT 0

SELECT

	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			wafprodcloudformationstac_ispj5m.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 19
		AND hour between 21 and 22
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-19 21:40:24'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

with old_breached_records as (
    select limit_name,
        limit_id,
        max(business_date) first_breach_date
    from "risk_prod"."limit_utilization"
    where is_breach = 'N'
    group by limit_name,
        limit_id
),
new_breached_records as (
    select limit_name,
        limit_id,
        min(business_date) first_breach_date
    from "risk_prod"."limit_utilization"
    where is_breach = 'Y'
        and limit_id not in (
            select limit_id
            from old_breached_records
        )
    group by limit_name,
        limit_id
),
first_breach_date as (
    select *
    from old_breached_records
    union all
    select *
    from new_breached_records
),
old_alert_records as (
    select limit_name,
        limit_id,
        max(business_date) first_alert_date
    from "risk_prod"."limit_utilization"
    where is_alert = 'N'
    group by limit_name,
        limit_id
),
new_alert_records as (
    select limit_name,
        limit_id,
        min(business_date) first_alert_date
    from "risk_prod"."limit_utilization"
    where is_alert = 'Y'
        and limit_id not in (
            select limit_id
            from old_alert_records
        )
    group by limit_name,
        limit_id
),
first_alert_date as (
    select *
    from old_alert_records
    union all
    select *
    from new_alert_records
)

	        (

	      INNER JOIN radar_reporting_uat.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst pos

			AND UPPER( pos.PRODUCT_TYPE ) <> 'NETTING'

	          parent.is_fi = 'Y'

	              SELECT 1
	              FROM radar_reporting_uat.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity sibling

			OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_uat.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p WHERE UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type )
		  )
		GROUP BY
	      parent.cppib_party_id,
	      parent.party_name,
	      parent.rtg_final
	  ),
	  child_level_exp_limits AS
	    (
	      SELECT
	        parent.cppib_party_id AS cppib_party_id_parent,
	        child.cppib_party_id AS cppib_party_id_child,
	        SUM( CASE WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' THEN fact.st_exposure ELSE 0 END ) AS st_exposure,
	        MAX( child.st_cash_pb_fi_limit ) AS st_smd_threshold,
	        SUM( CASE WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' THEN fact.mt_exposure ELSE 0 END ) AS mt_exposure,
	        MAX( child.mt_cash_pb_fi_limit ) AS mt_smd_threshold,
	        SUM( CASE WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' THEN fact.lt_exposure ELSE 0 END ) AS lt_exposure,
	        MAX( child.lt_cash_pb_fi_limit ) AS lt_smd_threshold

	        radar_reporting_uat.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity parent,
	        radar_reporting_uat.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity child,

	        AND fact.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
	        AND child.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = parent.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
	        AND fact.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst_id = pos.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst_id
	        AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) <> 'NETTING'
	        AND
	          (
	            parent.is_fi = 'Y'
	            OR child.is_fi = 'Y'
	            OR EXISTS
	              (
	                SELECT 1
	                FROM radar_reporting_uat.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity sibling

	                  and sibling.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = parent.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
	                  AND sibling.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id <> child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
	                  AND sibling.is_fi = 'Y'
	               )
	          )
			AND (
				EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_uat.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p WHERE p.product_type_category IN ( 'CASH', 'BONDS AND MONEY MARKET', 'PRIME BROKERAGE' ) AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type )
				OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_uat.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p WHERE UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type )
			  )
	      GROUP BY
	        parent.cppib_party_id,
	        child.cppib_party_id
	    ),
	  breaches_under_parents AS
	    (
			SELECT
            	cppib_party_id_parent AS cppib_party_id,
            	MIN
				  (
	                CASE
                        WHEN st_exposure / st_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
                            OR mt_exposure / mt_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
                            OR lt_exposure / lt_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
                            THEN 'YELLOW ALERT'
                        WHEN st_exposure / st_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
                            OR mt_exposure / mt_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
                            OR lt_exposure / lt_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
                            THEN 'ORANGE ALERT'
	                    WHEN st_exposure >= st_smd_threshold OR mt_exposure >= mt_smd_threshold OR lt_exposure >= lt_smd_threshold THEN 'EXCESS'
	                    ELSE 'OK'
	                END
	              ) AS status
            FROM child_level_exp_limits
            GROUP BY
            	cppib_party_id_parent
    	)
	SELECT
	  'Y' AS has_children,
	  c.party_name,
	  CASE
            WHEN SUM(st_exposure) / st_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
              OR SUM(mt_exposure) / mt_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
              OR SUM(lt_exposure) / lt_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
              THEN 'YELLOW ALERT'
            WHEN SUM(st_exposure) / st_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
                OR SUM(mt_exposure) / mt_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
                OR SUM(lt_exposure) / lt_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
                THEN 'ORANGE ALERT'
	        WHEN SUM( st_exposure ) >= st_smd_threshold THEN 'EXCESS'
	        WHEN SUM( mt_exposure ) >= mt_smd_threshold THEN 'EXCESS'
	        WHEN SUM( lt_exposure ) >= lt_smd_threshold THEN 'EXCESS'
		    ELSE COALESCE( MIN( b.status ), 'OK' )
	  END AS status,  
	  CASE
	    WHEN country_code = 'United States' THEN 'US'
		WHEN country_code = 'United Kingdom' THEN 'UK'
		ELSE country_code
	  END AS country_code,
	  COALESCE( rtg_final, '-' ) AS rtg_final,
	  COALESCE( rtg_outlook, '-' ) AS rtg_outlook,

	 SUM( st_exposure ) / 1000000 AS st_exposure,
	  COALESCE( format('%,.0f', truncate( ( SUM( st_exposure ) - SUM( prev_st_exposure ) ) / 1000000 ) ), '-' )  AS st_change_exposure,
      COALESCE(st_smd_threshold / 1000000, 0) AS st_smd_threshold,
      REPLACE(COALESCE(format('%,.0f', truncate((st_smd_threshold - GREATEST(0, SUM(st_exposure))) / 1000000)), '-'), '-0', '0') AS st_available,
	  CASE
	    WHEN st_smd_threshold = 0 OR st_smd_threshold IS NULL THEN 0
	    ELSE GREATEST( 0, SUM( st_exposure ) ) / st_smd_threshold * 100
	  END AS st_utilization,

	  SUM( mt_exposure ) / 1000000 AS mt_exposure,
	  COALESCE( format('%,.0f', truncate( ( SUM( mt_exposure ) - SUM( prev_mt_exposure ) ) / 1000000 ) ), '-' )  AS mt_change_exposure,
      COALESCE(mt_smd_threshold / 1000000, 0) AS mt_smd_threshold,
      REPLACE(COALESCE(format('%,.0f', truncate((mt_smd_threshold - GREATEST(0, SUM(mt_exposure))) / 1000000)), '-'), '-0', '0') AS mt_available,
	  CASE
	    WHEN mt_smd_threshold = 0 OR mt_smd_threshold IS NULL THEN 0
	    ELSE GREATEST( 0, SUM( mt_exposure ) ) / mt_smd_threshold * 100
	  END AS mt_utilization,

	  SUM( lt_exposure ) / 1000000 AS lt_exposure,
	  COALESCE( format('%,.0f', truncate( ( SUM( lt_exposure ) - SUM( prev_lt_exposure ) ) / 1000000 ) ), '-' )  AS lt_change_exposure,
      COALESCE(lt_smd_threshold / 1000000, 0) AS lt_smd_threshold,
      REPLACE(COALESCE(format('%,.0f', truncate((lt_smd_threshold - GREATEST(0, SUM(lt_exposure))) / 1000000)), '-'), '-0', '0') AS lt_available,
	  CASE
	    WHEN lt_smd_threshold = 0 OR lt_smd_threshold IS NULL THEN 0
	    ELSE GREATEST( 0, SUM( lt_exposure ) ) / lt_smd_threshold * 100
	  END AS lt_utilization,

	  MAX( p.prev_rtg_final ) AS prev_rtg_final,
	  dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id,
	  CASE WHEN SUM( st_exposure ) >= st_smd_threshold THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS st_limit_blown,
	  CASE WHEN SUM( mt_exposure ) >= mt_smd_threshold THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS mt_limit_blown,
	  CASE WHEN SUM( lt_exposure ) >= lt_smd_threshold THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS lt_limit_blown
	FROM current_exposure c
	LEFT JOIN breaches_under_parents b ON c.cppib_party_id = b.cppib_party_id
	LEFT JOIN prev_exposure p
  ON c.cppib_party_id = p.cppib_party_id
	  OR c.party_name = p.party_name
	GROUP BY
        st_smd_threshold,
        mt_smd_threshold,
        lt_smd_threshold,
	  dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id,
	  c.party_name,
	  country_code,
	  rtg_final,
	  rtg_outlook
    ORDER BY
		CASE
            WHEN status = 'YELLOW ALERT' THEN 1
            WHEN status = 'ORANGE ALERT' THEN 2
            WHEN status = 'EXCESS' THEN 3
            ELSE 4
		END,
		ST_EXPOSURE DESC,
		party_name ASC

	  COALESCE( format('%,.0f', truncate( ( SUM( st_exposure ) - SUM( prev_st_exposure ) ) / 1000000 ) ), '-' )  AS st_change_exposure,
      COALESCE(st_smd_threshold / 1000000, 0) AS st_smd_threshold,
      REPLACE(COALESCE(format('%,.0f', truncate((st_smd_threshold - GREATEST(0, SUM(st_exposure))) / 1000000)), '-'), '-0', '0') AS st_available,
	  CASE
	    WHEN st_smd_threshold = 0 OR st_smd_threshold IS NULL THEN 0
	    ELSE GREATEST( 0, SUM( st_exposure ) ) / st_smd_threshold * 100
	  END AS st_utilization,

	  SUM( mt_exposure ) / 1000000 AS mt_exposure,
	  COALESCE( format('%,.0f', truncate( ( SUM( mt_exposure ) - SUM( prev_mt_exposure ) ) / 1000000 ) ), '-' )  AS mt_change_exposure,
      COALESCE(mt_smd_threshold / 1000000, 0) AS mt_smd_threshold,
      REPLACE(COALESCE(format('%,.0f', truncate((mt_smd_threshold - GREATEST(0, SUM(mt_exposure))) / 1000000)), '-'), '-0', '0') AS mt_available,
	  CASE
	    WHEN mt_smd_threshold = 0 OR mt_smd_threshold IS NULL THEN 0
	    ELSE GREATEST( 0, SUM( mt_exposure ) ) / mt_smd_threshold * 100
	  END AS mt_utilization,

	  SUM( lt_exposure ) / 1000000 AS lt_exposure,
	  COALESCE( format('%,.0f', truncate( ( SUM( lt_exposure ) - SUM( prev_lt_exposure ) ) / 1000000 ) ), '-' )  AS lt_change_exposure,
      COALESCE(lt_smd_threshold / 1000000, 0) AS lt_smd_threshold,
      REPLACE(COALESCE(format('%,.0f', truncate((lt_smd_threshold - GREATEST(0, SUM(lt_exposure))) / 1000000)), '-'), '-0', '0') AS lt_available,
	  CASE
	    WHEN lt_smd_threshold = 0 OR lt_smd_threshold IS NULL THEN 0
	    ELSE GREATEST( 0, SUM( lt_exposure ) ) / lt_smd_threshold * 100
	  END AS lt_utilization,

	  MAX( p.prev_rtg_final ) AS prev_rtg_final,
	  dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id,
	  CASE WHEN SUM( st_exposure ) >= st_smd_threshold THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS st_limit_blown,
	  CASE WHEN SUM( mt_exposure ) >= mt_smd_threshold THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS mt_limit_blown,
	  CASE WHEN SUM( lt_exposure ) >= lt_smd_threshold THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS lt_limit_blown
	FROM current_exposure c
	LEFT JOIN breaches_under_parents b ON c.cppib_party_id = b.cppib_party_id
	LEFT JOIN prev_exposure p
  ON c.cppib_party_id = p.cppib_party_id
	  OR c.party_name = p.party_name
	GROUP BY
        st_smd_threshold,
        mt_smd_threshold,
        lt_smd_threshold,
	  dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id,
	  c.party_name,
	  country_code,
	  rtg_final,
	  rtg_outlook
    ORDER BY
		CASE
            WHEN status = 'YELLOW ALERT' THEN 1
            WHEN status = 'ORANGE ALERT' THEN 2
            WHEN status = 'EXCESS' THEN 3
            ELSE 4
		END,
		ST_EXPOSURE DESC,
